1. Load station data
2. Load UVP6 and CTD data to get max tow depths
3. Calculate % of bottom depth with cast

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggOceanMaps)
library(ggrepel)
library(cowplot)
`%notin%` <- Negate(`%in%`)
```

# 1. Load station data from Excel
```{r, eval=FALSE}
stns_2021 <- readxl::read_xlsx("C:/Sync/UVP6_Data/UVP6_Data_Overview.xlsx",
                                   sheet = "2021_stations") %>% 
  mutate(Cruise = "darkedge") %>% 
  select(-`UTC\r\nTime`)
stns_2023 <- readxl::read_xlsx("C:/Sync/UVP6_Data/UVP6_Data_Overview.xlsx",
                                   sheet = "2023_stations") %>% 
  mutate(Cruise = "amundsen_2023")
stns_2024 <- readxl::read_xlsx("C:/Sync/UVP6_Data/UVP6_Data_Overview.xlsx",
                                   sheet = "2024_stations") %>% 
  mutate(Cruise = paste0("am_leg", Leg))

stns_meta <- bind_rows(stns_2021, stns_2023, stns_2024)
rm(stns_2021, stns_2023, stns_2024)

# Export this data frame to append the station name formating that matches UVP6.
write.csv(file = "data/Amundsen_stations_list.csv",
          stns_meta, row.names = F)
```

# 2. Load UVP6 and CTD data
```{r}
load("data/uvp6_CNN_segmentations_morphotraits_20251208.RData")
rm(all.copepods.uvp6)

stns_meta <- read.csv("data/Amundsen_stations_list_ed20251201.csv") %>% 
  select(sample_cruise = Cruise,  
         sample_stationid = station_id,
         Amund_Station_ID = Station.ID,
         bottom_depth_m = `Depth..m.`) %>% 
  filter(sample_stationid != "") %>% 
  # Choose max depth
  group_by(sample_cruise, sample_stationid) %>% 
  mutate(bottom_depth_m = max(bottom_depth_m)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  distinct(sample_cruise, sample_stationid, .keep_all = T)

# Add bottom depth to Amund_UVP metadata
Amund_UVP6_meta <- Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
  # For 2021 darkedge, the station id is only the first segment
  mutate(sample_stationid_ed = if_else(sample_cruise == "darkedge",
                                       str_extract(sample_id, "^[^_]+"), 
                                       sample_stationid)) %>% 
  mutate(sample_stationid_ed = if_else(sample_id == "de_bb2_float",
                                       "de_bb2_float", sample_stationid_ed)) %>% 
  left_join(stns_meta, 
            by = join_by(sample_cruise, 
                         sample_stationid_ed == sample_stationid)) %>% 
    # For profiles with no assigned bottom dpeth, use the max sampling depth
  mutate(bottom_depth_m = if_else(is.na(bottom_depth_m), 
                                  maxSampleDepth, bottom_depth_m)) %>%
  # Correct the bottom depth for am_leg5_TCA_T3_03_01
  mutate(bottom_depth_m = if_else(sample_id == "am_leg5_TCA_T3_03_01", 
                                  maxSampleDepth, bottom_depth_m)) %>%
  # Cast ratio
  mutate(castratio = maxSampleDepth / bottom_depth_m ) %>% 
  mutate(castratio = if_else(castratio > 1, 1, castratio)) 


```

# 3. Additional curation of the metadata files
## Select profiles with segmented images
```{r}
# Load the list of images for analysis
load("data/uvp6_images_calculated_traits_20251210.RData")

# The volume sampled in each UVP profile and region names/color
load("data/UVP6_sample_volume_5m_20251211.RData")

# Samples with segmented Calanus spp images
valid_profiles <- indiv_traits %>% 
  # filter(source %in% c("RF Calanus spp", "CNN segmentation",
  #                      "Manual segmentation")) %>% 
  group_by(sample_id, profile_group, region, region.inuktitut) %>% 
  summarise(nCalanusImages = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Retain only the sample_ids used in the analysis
volumes.df <- volumes.df %>% 
  filter(sample_id %in% valid_profiles$sample_id)

# Add the min and max 5m depth bins of the UVP6 cast and add to the metadata
volumes.sum <- volumes.df %>% 
  group_by(sample_id) %>% 
  summarise(min5mDepth = min(Depth_5m),
            max5mDepth = max(Depth_5m),
            totalProfileVolume_m3 = sum(Sampled_volume_m3),
            n5mbins = n(), .groups = "drop") 

# Filter the samples with segmented Calanus images
Amund_UVP6_meta <- valid_profiles %>% 
  left_join(Amund_UVP6_meta, by = "sample_id") %>% 
  left_join(volumes.sum, by = "sample_id") %>% 
  select(-object_id) 

# Check the distribution of NCalanusImages per sampling year
ggplot(Amund_UVP6_meta, aes(x = nCalanusImages, color = as.factor(Year))) +
  geom_density()


# Check which profiles do not sample the entire bottom depth
ggplot(Amund_UVP6_meta, aes(x = maxSampleDepth, y = bottom_depth_m)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = sample_cruise)) +
  geom_abline()

# # How many images in total per profile?
plot_grid(
ggplot(valid_profiles, aes(x = nCalanusImages)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 10) +
  ggtitle("Images per profile"),

ggplot(valid_profiles %>%
         group_by(profile_group) %>%
         summarise(nCalanusImages = sum(nCalanusImages)), aes(x = nCalanusImages)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  ggtitle("Images per profile-group") )
# ggsave("figures/image_count_profiles_2.png",
#        width = 8, height = 4, units = "in", bg = "white")

# ## Check image counts between Calanus spp and Copepoda > 3mm
AA <- indiv_traits %>%
  mutate(source2 = if_else(source %in% c("RF Calanus spp", "CNN segmentation",
                       "Manual segmentation"),
                       "Calanus","Copepoda3mm") ) %>%
  mutate(Cruise = if_else(grepl("am_", Cruise) == T, "amundsen2024", Cruise)) %>% 
   group_by(Cruise, sample_id, profile_group, region, region.inuktitut, source2) %>%
  summarise(nimages = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = source2, values_from = nimages,
              values_fill = 0)

ggplot(AA, aes(x = Calanus, y = Copepoda3mm,
               color = region.inuktitut,
               shape = Cruise)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline() +
  scale_color_manual(values = unique(region_rename$region.color),
                     name = "Region") +
  ggtitle("Number of images per UVP6 profile")

# ggsave("figures/image_count_profiles.png",
#        width = 8, height = 5, units = "in", bg = "white")
```

## Filter profiles based on depth and N images
```{r}
# Exclude profiles 
# TODO verify this filter
to_exclude <- Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
  filter(bottom_depth_m < 100 | nCalanusImages < 10 |
           castratio < 0.5) 

# number of images not used 
sum(to_exclude$nCalanusImages)
```


# 4. Prepare metadata of profile groups and export
```{r}
# Calculate profile group centroids
pg_meta <- Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
  filter(sample_id %notin% to_exclude$sample_id) %>% 
  mutate(uvp6_date = lubridate::ymd_hms(paste(object_date, object_time))) %>% 
  group_by(sample_cruise, region.inuktitut, region, profile_group) %>% 
  summarise(longitude = mean(object_lon),
            latitude = mean(object_lat),
            date = mean(uvp6_date),
            min_bottom_depth = min(bottom_depth_m),
            min_cast_depth = min(maxSampleDepth),
            max_bottom_depth = max(bottom_depth_m),
            max_cast_depth = max(maxSampleDepth),
            nprofiles = n(),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  arrange(region.inuktitut, latitude) %>% 
  group_by(region) %>% 
  mutate(total_profiles = sum(nprofiles)) %>% 
  ungroup()

# Number of profiles and profile groups by region
pg_meta %>% 
  group_by(region, region.inuktitut) %>% 
  summarise(n_profilegroups = n(),
            n_profiles = sum(nprofiles),
            .groups = "drop")

Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
  filter(sample_id %notin% to_exclude$sample_id) %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut, Month_Name) %>% 
  count() %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Month_Name, values_from = n) %>% 
  select(region.inuktitut, July, August, September, October)

Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
  filter(sample_id %notin% to_exclude$sample_id) %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut, Year) %>% 
  count()
```

# 5. Figure 2 Map
```{r, fig.width=6}
load("data/UVP6_Calanus_metadata_20260129.RData")
region_rename <- data.frame(
  region = c("Baffin Bay", "Baffin Shelf", 
             "Davis Strait", "Lancaster Sound",
             "North Water Polynya", "Labrador Shelf", 
              "Nares Strait"),
  region.inuktitut = c("Sannirutiup Imavik\n(Baffin Bay)", 
                       "Qikiqtaaluk Shelf\n(Baffin Shelf)",
                       "Qikiqtaaluup Ikinga\n(Davis Strait)", 
                       "Tallurutiup Imanga\n(Lancaster Sound)",
                       "Pikialasorsuaq\n(North Water Polynya)", 
                       "Nunatsiavut Shelf\n(Labrador Shelf)",
                       "Sarvarjuaq\n(Nares Strait)"),
  region.color = c("goldenrod2","purple2","turquoise2","forestgreen",
                   "deeppink1","blue1", "sienna2")) %>% 
  # order regions as factors by latitude
  mutate(region.inuktitut = factor(
    region.inuktitut,
    levels = c("Sarvarjuaq\n(Nares Strait)",
               "Pikialasorsuaq\n(North Water Polynya)", 
               "Tallurutiup Imanga\n(Lancaster Sound)",
               "Sannirutiup Imavik\n(Baffin Bay)", 
               "Qikiqtaaluup Ikinga\n(Davis Strait)", 
               "Qikiqtaaluk Shelf\n(Baffin Shelf)",
               "Nunatsiavut Shelf\n(Labrador Shelf)"
    ))) %>% 
  arrange(region.inuktitut)

clrs <- unique(region_rename$region.color)

p <- basemap("ArcticStereographic", bathymetry = T, glaciers = FALSE,
        limits = c(-85,-52,54,83), rotate = T,
        legends = TRUE, land.col = "#eeeac4",  bathy.style = "poly_grays",
        land.border.col = "black", gla.border.col = NA) +
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_point(data = Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
                                  filter(sample_id %notin% to_exclude$sample_id) %>% 
                                  mutate(Year = as.factor(Year)),
                                aes(x = object_lon, y = object_lat, 
                                    # shape = Year,
                                    color = region.inuktitut),
                                size = 4, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = clrs, name = "Region") +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.key.spacing.y = unit(0.2, "cm"),
        legend.position = c(0.025, 0.025),
        legend.justification = c("left", "bottom"),
        legend.margin = ggplot2::margin(5,5,5,5),
        legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black")) 

# 1) Make a version that shows ONLY the fill legend (from basemap)
fill_leg <- cowplot::get_legend(
  p + theme(legend.position = "right") +
    guides(colour = "none", color  = "none", shape  = "none") )

# 2) Make the main plot with NO fill legend (keep your bottom-left legend)
p_main <- p + guides(fill = "none")

# 3) Overlay the extracted fill legend into the upper-right corner
p_final <- cowplot::ggdraw(p_main) +
  cowplot::draw_grob(
    fill_leg,
    x = 0.72, y = 0.66,   # position (0–1)
    width = 0.26, height = 0.26
  )

p_final

ggsave("figures/Fig2_samples_map_by_region_289_OSM.png", width = 6, height = 8,
       units = "in", bg = "white")

basemap("ArcticStereographic", bathymetry = T, glaciers = FALSE,
        limits = c(-85,-52,54,83), rotate = T,
        legends = TRUE, land.col = "gray60",  bathy.style = "contour_grays",
        land.border.col = "black", gla.border.col = NA) +
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_point(data = Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
                                  filter(sample_id %notin% to_exclude$sample_id) %>% 
                                  mutate(Year = as.factor(Year)),
                                aes(x = object_lon, y = object_lat, 
                                    fill = region.inuktitut),
                                size = 5, alpha = 0.9, 
                                color = "black", shape = 21) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = region_rename$region.color, name = "Region") +
  # theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
  #       axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
  #       legend.position = "none") 

  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
        legend.position = c(0.02, 0.02), 
        legend.justification = c("left", "bottom"),
        legend.margin = ggplot2::margin(6,6,6,6),
        legend.box.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"))



ggsave("figures/Fig2_samples_map_by_region_289_OSM_withlegend.png", width = 6, height = 8,
       units = "in", bg = "white")
```


# -- old scripts --

## Get profile summaries from excel file instead
```{r, eval=FALSE}

# Use the profile lists instead of metadata?
profiles_list <- readxl::read_xlsx("C:/Sync/UVP6_Data/UVP6_Data_Overview.xlsx",
                                   sheet = "ECOPART_summary") %>% 
  mutate(Year = as.factor(year(`yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm`))) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(region)) %>% 
  left_join(region_rename, by = "region") %>% 
  # Add month and year
  mutate(Month = month(`yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm`, label = T),
         DOY = yday(`yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm`)) %>% 
  rename(sample_id = Profile, 
         sample_cruise = Cruise,
         sample_stationid = Site) %>% 
  filter(sample_id %in% Amund_UVP6_meta$sample_id)
  

# Number of profiles and profile groups by region
profiles_list %>% 
  group_by(cruise_name, profile_group, region.inuktitut) %>% 
  count() %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut) %>% 
  summarise(n_profilegroups = n(),
            n_profiles = sum(n),
            .groups = "drop")
```

#  Inspect profiles for organizing profile_groups
## 2021 Dark Edge
```{r, eval=FALSE}
df_subset <- Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
  filter(sample_cruise == "darkedge")

basemap("ArcticStereographic", bathymetry = FALSE, glaciers = FALSE,
        # limits = c(-90,-50,64,83), rotate = T,
        limits = c(-90,-60,74,80), rotate = T,
        legends = TRUE, land.col = "#eeeac4",  bathy.style = "poly_grays",
        land.border.col = "black", gla.border.col = NA) +
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_point(data = df_subset,
                                aes(x = object_lon, y = object_lat, 
                                    color = sample_id),
                                size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
  # Plot the labels
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_text_repel(data = df_subset,
                                aes(x = object_lon, y = object_lat,
                                    label = sample_stationid_ed,
                                    color = sample_id),
                                max.overlaps = 20, size = 2) +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none") +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position="top", title.hjust = 0.5))

# Plot casts depths chronologically
ggplot(df_subset,
       aes(x = object_date, y = maxSampleDepth,
           color = sample_id)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = sample_id), size = 2, max.repel = 20)
  

ggplot(df_subset,
       aes(x = sample_id, y = maxSampleDepth, color = object_date)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = 0, ymax = maxSampleDepth)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_point(aes(y = bottom_depth_m), color = "red", shape = 4) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```

### Check Darkedge profile depths

```{r, eval=FALSE}
df_subset <- Amund_UVP6_meta %>% 
  filter(sample_cruise == "am_leg2") %>% 
  # filter(object_date > "2024-07-28") %>% 
  arrange(object_date)
df_subset <- df_subset %>% 
  mutate(sample_id = factor(sample_id,
                            levels = df_subset$sample_id))

basemap("ArcticStereographic", bathymetry = FALSE, glaciers = FALSE,
        # limits = c(-70,-55,50,62), rotate = T,
        limits = c(-65,-55,52,57), rotate = T,
        legends = TRUE, land.col = "#eeeac4",  bathy.style = "poly_grays",
        land.border.col = "black", gla.border.col = NA) +
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_point(data = df_subset,
                                aes(x = object_lon, y = object_lat, 
                                    color = sample_id),
                                size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
  # Plot the labels
  ggspatial::geom_spatial_text_repel(data = df_subset,
                                aes(x = object_lon, y = object_lat,
                                    label = sample_stationid,
                                    color = sample_id),
                                max.overlaps = 20, size = 2) +
  theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none") +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position="top", title.hjust = 0.5))

# Plot casts depths chronologically
ggplot(df_subset,
       aes(x = object_date, y = maxSampleDepth,
           color = sample_id)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = sample_stationid), size = 2, max.repel = 20) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
  

ggplot(df_subset,
       aes(x = sample_id, y = maxSampleDepth, color = object_date)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = 0, ymax = maxSampleDepth)) +
  geom_point() +
  # geom_point(aes(y = bottom_depth_m), color = "red", shape = 4) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  # scale_y_reverse() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, size = 5, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "none") 
```
